analysis_md:
$\Omega$ 在球面坐标系下为 $\begin{cases}0\leq\theta\leq 2\pi\\0\leq\varphi\leq\frac{\pi}{4}\\0\leq r\leq\cos\varphi\end{cases}$，所以

$I=\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}}d\varphi\int_0^{\cos\varphi}r^3\sin\varphi\,dr=\frac{\pi}{2}\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\sin\varphi\cos^4\varphi\,d\varphi=-\frac{\pi}{2}\cdot\frac{\cos^5\varphi}{5}\big|_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}}=\frac{\pi}{10}(1-\frac{\sqrt{2}}{8})$。
